name: Jindai-zakura (Yamataka Jindai Cherry)
description: The Jindai-zakura at Jissoji temple in Hokuto City is an Edo-higan cherry estimated at about 2,000 years old — Japan's oldest known cherry tree — and was the very first National Natural Monument designated in 1922. It is one of Japan's Three Great Cherry Trees.
highlights: One of Japan's Three Great Cherry Trees
notes: Free to view in the grounds of Jissoji temple. The tree is supported by many braces and ropes, a sign of its extreme age. Best seen mid-April. Access is by car (about 35 min from Kofu City via Route 141); the nearest station is Nagasaka on the JR Chuo Line, about 20 min by taxi.
